name: nodestack
description: The TypeScript-Native Backend Stack. Single-process backend with embedded SQLite, instant CRUD, Auth, Realtime, Files & Admin UI.

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/admin/ui', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('src/admin/ui/index.html', 'dist/admin/ui/index.html'); if (fs.existsSync('src/admin/ui/icon.svg')) fs.copyFileSync('src/admin/ui/icon.svg', 'dist/admin/ui/icon.svg'); if (fs.existsSync('src/admin/ui/favicon.svg')) fs.copyFileSync('src/admin/ui/favicon.svg', 'dist/admin/ui/favicon.svg');"
